Coal India Plans IPOs for Mahanadi Coalfields and Two Subsidiaries

Coal India is planning an Initial Public Offering (IPO) for its subsidiary Mahanadi Coalfields Limited (MCL), described as a "cash cow" that generates a third of Coal India's profit and is debt-free. Despite its financial strength and trading at a discount to peers, potential investors are advised to consider pricing curbs and levy risks. Following the MCL IPO, Coal India intends to launch two more subsidiary IPOs.
